# Unichain Overview

Learn what Unichain is and how it supports faster, lower-cost onchain liquidity and cross-chain interoperability.

## [What is Unichain?](https://developers.uniswap.org/docs/unichain\#what-is-unichain)

Unichain is a DeFi-focused Ethereum L2 designed for fast blocks, lower costs, and efficient onchain liquidity across chains.

### [Stage 1 rollup](https://developers.uniswap.org/docs/unichain\#stage-1-rollup)

Unichain is an Ethereum L2 with a permissionless fault-proof system designed for trust-minimized security.

### [Instant transactions](https://developers.uniswap.org/docs/unichain\#instant-transactions)

Unichain supports 1-second block times, with 200 ms preconfirmations available through Flashblocks. Lower latency improves market efficiency by increasing arbitrage frequency and reducing value lost to MEV.

### [Reduced costs and further decentralization](https://developers.uniswap.org/docs/unichain\#reduced-costs-and-further-decentralization)

Unichain is designed to align with Ethereum's scaling roadmap by moving execution to an L2. This can reduce transaction costs significantly over time. While Unichain uses a sequencer for execution efficiency, full nodes can verify blocks independently.

### [Cross-chain liquidity](https://developers.uniswap.org/docs/unichain\#cross-chain-liquidity)

Unichain supports interoperability across multiple chains. As part of the Superchain, Unichain supports native [interoperability](https://docs.optimism.io/get-started/interop) and cross-chain liquidity access.

## [Where to Go Next](https://developers.uniswap.org/docs/unichain\#where-to-go-next)

- [Read the Unichain Whitepaper](https://developers.uniswap.org/whitepaper_unichain.pdf)
- [Get started with wallets, funds, and nodes](https://developers.uniswap.org/docs/unichain/getting-started/setting-up-a-wallet)
- [Build apps and contracts on Unichain](https://developers.uniswap.org/docs/unichain/guides/deploy-a-smart-contract)
- [Review network and contract reference docs](https://developers.uniswap.org/docs/unichain/technical-information/network-information)
